title: Put Your ElevenLabs Voice Agent on a Website: The Widget
desc:
The fastest way to put an ElevenLabs agent in front of users is the website widget. This episode covers the embed snippet and where it goes, the public-agent and Allowlist settings, voice-only vs voice plus text vs chat mode, the HTML attributes for layout, colors and button text, safe markdown links, passing dynamic variables and overrides from the page, the Widget tab options like feedback and terms, and a client tool that opens a link from the conversation.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
